companyDescription.title: Company Description
companyDescription.text:
Sopra Steria is a European leader in consulting, digital services, and software development, supporting its clients in their digital transformation through innovative and collaborative solutions. With 50,000 employees in nearly 30 countries and a revenue of €5.1 billion in 2022, we are committed to achieving sustainable results and placing people at the heart of technology. The world is how we shape it. For more information, visit us at www.soprasteria.com.

Are you ready to take on the challenge with us?

Join Sopra Steria Aeroline and become part of a forward-thinking team shaping the future of aerospace through digital innovation. If you are passionate about managing business accounts, aerospace technologies, and want to make a meaningful impact, we want to meet you! Apply now to embark on an exciting career with us.

jobDescription.title: Job Description
jobDescription.text:
We are looking for a Business Analyst to join our dynamic team. You will take on the Business Analyst role within an Agile team for the development of specific shopfloor/Manufacturing applications in the aerospace sector. You will collaborate closely with cross-functional and international teams to ensure the successful delivery of projects within scope, timeline, and budget, while maintaining the highest standards of quality and compliance.

Key Responsibilities

  • Business needs analysis and workshop facilitation
  • Ability to discuss with shopfloor people to understand specific requirements
  • Definition and scoping of user needs and User Stories
  • Writing functional specifications and consolidating existing functional specifications
  • Writing test plans and participating in IT test execution
  • Support for business testing
  • Participation in continuous improvement
  • Quality control of deliverables and their level of quality

qualifications.title: Qualifications
qualifications.text:
• Experience as a Business Analyst within a software development team
  • Experience as a Business Analyst within shopfloor/Manufacturing applications
  • Experience with Agile management tools (Jira) and AzureDevOps
  • Bachelor’s degree in industrial, mechanical, aeronautical, computer science, or a related field
  • Excellent technical and functional understanding of manufacturing and assembly processes in the aeronautical sector
  • Strong adaptability skills, excellent interpersonal skills, and a genuine appreciation for teamwork
  • Strong organizational skills
  • Knowledge of digital technologies and their applications in the aerospace sector
  • Understanding of aerospace industry regulations, standards, and best practices

Languages

  • English
  • French is a plus

additionalInformation.title: Additional Information
additionalInformation.text:

Grow With Us

Certified Excellence
We’re proud to be recognized as a “Great Place to Work"

We thank all applicants for showing an interest in this position. Please note that only shortlisted candidates will be contacted for further steps in the selection process.

Sopra Steria is an equal opportunity employer, committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace. Our company works everyday to combat all forms of discrimination and promote a respectful working environment. Accommodations are available on request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the selection process.
